checks: 19 exact native tests twice debug/release; repeated syntax; three compiled source mutants
cost: Whole-file reads O(B) space/time plus parsing; term BTree inserts O(T log T), penalty override O(Pcommon*Pown), own-rule snapshot clones all rules. Cover O(total term-list bytes), severity/authority substring scan O(patterns*text length).
description: Jurisdiction TSV loading, vocabulary covers and ordered lookup policies.
forward: Load metadata/id/principles, merge common+own terms by head preserving first insertion order, remove overridden common penalties, read optional rules/authorities/flags/devices. load_all snapshots own rules then prepends direct inherited lists. cover selects Sure equality/narrow before Broad; severity max rank, authority first matching pattern.
inverse: Excluded successful loads include absent jurisdiction id and unknown inheritance target. Cover cannot return No for equal words. Authority cannot select a later matching pattern over an earlier one; this does not validate external law tables.

Loaded state has all TSV antecedents with same trimmed rows, overwrite winners and direct inherited snapshots. Comments, whitespace and overridden rows are unrecoverable; equal severity observations allow many matching penalties and texts.
Cover is max of No/Broad/Sure membership evidence, with equality Sure. Opposite is directional: narrow(rule) and opposite(case); reversing words need not preserve truth.

Replacing common term by same head changes definition without moving its first-seen order; term_of returns first broad-containing term even when another term supplies Sure cover. Plain reading can therefore depend on order.
severity lowercases penalty and selects maximal rank, last equal rank wins; authority lowercases name then first substring wins regardless of rank. Empty pattern matches any string.

load_all takes own map before extension. A inherits B and B inherits C does not imply A receives C; repeated inherits rows duplicate rules, and duplicate IDs overwrite own map entries. No transitive closure or dedup.
limitations: Partial source-derived models and finite correspondence only
No live parser/corpus/frozen gold or protocol filesystem effects; no percentage surrogate
state: Finite synthetic rule/case states; valid indices, bounded paths, successful allocations. No legal authority claim.
